results.title: Trump ya nada Miller a mukamin sabon shugaban fadar White House
results.content: Shugaban Amurka Donald Trump ya naɗa Stephen Miller, wanda ya tsara manufofinsa masu tsauri kan shige da fice, a matsayin sabon shugaban ma’aikatansa fadar White House, biyo bayan rashin nasarar da jam’iyyar Republican ta yi a zaɓen tsakiyar wa’adi.

results.title: Kurdawa na samun nasara a kan mayakan ISIS a Syria
results.content: Dubban yan gudun hijira na ci gaba da tserewa fadan da ake tabkawa tsakanin Kurdawa da mayakan Jihadin kungiyar Isis a kasar Syriya al'amarin da ya haifar da kwararar 'yan gudun hijira a kasar Turkiya.

results.title: An samu raguwar kona motoci a bikin sabuwar shekara a Faransa
results.content: Gwamnatin Faransa tace an samu raguwar yawan adadin motocin da ake konewa a lokacin bikin sabuwar shekara da kashi 12 cikin 100 a cikin kasar. alkalumma sun nuna cewa a jajibirin sabuwar shekara an kone motoci 940 sabanin 1,067, da aka cinna wa wuta a shekarar da ta gabata.

results.title: Za ni samarwa ƴan Najeriya da kyakkyawar makoma -Tinubu
results.content: Shugaban Najeriya Bola Tinubu ya yi alkawarin samar da kyakkyawar makoma ga ƴan Najeriya, yayin da ya soki tsohon mataimakin shugaban ƙasa Atiku Abubakar da Peter Obi, inda ya bayyana cewa ba su da halayen shugabanci da ake bukata don tafiyar da Najeriya.

results.title: Kotun Duniya ta bukaci Afirka ta Kudu ta cafke El-Bashir
results.content: Kotun hukunta manyan laifufuka a duniya ICC ko kuma CPI ta bukaci hukumomin kasar Afirka ta kudu da su kama shugaban Sudan Umar Hasan El-bashir wanda ke halarar taron shugabannin Afirka yanzu haka a birnin Johannesburg.

results.title: An cafke mutane da dama kan zargin juyin mulki a Gambia
results.content: An cafke mutane da dama, da ake zargi suna da hannu a yunkurin jurin juyin mulkin da aka yi a kasar Gambia, lokacin da shugaban kasa Yahya Jammeh ke ziyara a birnin Dubai, wanda kuma ya dora alhakin harin kan ‘yan kasashen waje da bai bayyana sunayen su ba.

results.title: Atiku zai ci gaba da tafiyarsa a fagen siyasa musaman ganin ya samu nasara a 2027- ADC
results.content: Tsohon mataimakin shugaban ƙasa Atiku Abubakar ya yi watsi da hukuncin kotu na baya-bayan nan da ya shafi jam'iyyarsa ta ADC, yana mai cewa zai ci gaba da tafiyarsa a fagen siyasa musaman ganin ya samu nasara a zaɓen 2027.

results.title: Ambaliyar Ruwan sama ta yi sanadiyar mutuwar mutane 12 a Jojiya
results.content: yanzu haka dai masu kula da namun daji na ci gaba da farautar namun daji a tsakkiyar birnin Tbilissi na kasar Jojiya, bayan da ambaliyar Ruwan sama da aka sheka a birnin ta rusa gidan namun dajin da a halin yanzu suka fantsama a cikin gari

results.title: Ana ci gaba da aikin neman tarkacen jirgin AirAsia
results.content: Yau Juma’a masu aiki neman sassan jirgin saman da ya yi hadari a kan tekun Java na kasar Indonesia, sun ci gaba da aikin, kuma suna gab da kaiwa inda lamarin ya faru. An dakatar da aikin neman Jirgin ne saboda matsalar Yanayi a tekun Indonesia

results.title: Gwamnatin Kano ta goyi bayan hukuncin rataya kan matasan da suka yi kisa a Ɗorayi
results.content: Babbar kotun jihar Kano ta yankewa wasu matasa biyu hukuncin kisa ta hanyar rataya, bayan samunsu da laifin hallaka wata mata da yaranta guda 6 unguwar Ɗorayi Chiranci da ke jihar.

results.title: Taron Kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25
results.content: A yau lahadi ake buda taron shugabannin kasashen kungiyar Tarayyar Afirka karo na 25 a birnin Jonnesburg na kasar Afirka ta Kudu, taron da zai mayar da hankali kan batutuwa da dama da suka shafi kasashen nahiyar.

results.title: Jami’an Italiya sun yi kokarin ceto jirgin ruwan Bakin haure
results.content: Jami’an kula da jiragen ruwa a kasar Italiya sun nasarar ceto wani jirgin ruwa da ya samu matsala a tsakiyar teku shake da bakin haure kimanin 450 bayan sun yi nasarar ceto rayuwan bakin haure da dama a cikin kwanaki biyu da suka gabata.

results.title: Rikici ya tilastawa dubban mutane tserewa daga muhallansu a Najeriya, Nijar da Benin-MDD
results.content: Majalisa Ɗinkin Duniya ta ce dubban mutane sun tsallake iyakokin Najeriya, Jamhuriyar Nijar da kuma Benin domin neman mafaka, a sakamakon tashin hankali da rikice-rikice da ke faruwa a sassan ƙasashen.

results.title: Kotu ba ta amince da tsige shugaba Rajoanarimampianina ba
results.content: Kotun kolin kasar Madagascar ta yi watsi da matakin tsige shugaban kasar Hery Rajoana-rimampianina da majalisar dokokin kasar ta yi a ranar 26 ga watan jiya.

results.title: An sake zabar Netanyahu a matsayin shugaban Jam’iyya mai mulki
results.content: An sake zabar Fraiministan kasar Isra’ila Benjamin Netanyahu, a matsayin shugaban jam’iyyar Likud mai mulkin kasar, a wani zaben fitar da gwanin da aka yi jiya Alhamis. Zaben na zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da ake shirin yin wani zaben gaggawa a kasar, inda ya kayar da abokin takarar shi Danny Danon mai ra’ayin gurguzu.

results.title: Wasu daga cikin muhimman labaran mako daga Rfi hausa
results.content: Shirin na wannan makon zai soma daga Amurka inda Jam’iyar Democrat ta kwace iko da majalisun dokokin Amurka, bayan da ta yi wa jam’iyyar Republican ta shugaba Donald Trump mummunan kaye a zaɓen tsakiyar wa'adi da aka gudanar ranar 3 ga wannan watan na Nuwamba.

results.title: Sarkozy ya soki kawance da ke fada da mayakan IS
results.content: Tsohon shugaban Faransa Nicolas Sarkozy ya yi kakkausar ga kawancen dakarun kasashen duniya a karkashin jagorancin Amurka, dangane da yadda ya kasa murkushe mayakan da ke da’awar jihadi a kasashen Syria da Iraki.

results.title: Ɗaukaka ƙara daga ADC za ta dakatar da hukuncin kotu kan Atiku da jam'iyyar?
results.content: A cikin shirin namu na yau, za mu ji cewa Babbar Kotun Tarayya ta soke shugabancin jam’iyyar ADC ƙarƙashin Sanata David Mark, tare da dukkan matakan da ya samar da tsohon mataimakin shugaban ƙasa, Atiku Abubakar, a matsayin ɗan takarar shugaban ƙasa a jam’iyyar a zaɓen 2027. Za mu ji martanin Nafiu Bala Gombe, wanda ya shigar da ƙarar, da kuma martanin tawagar Atiku.

results.title: Hillary na gudanar da yakin neman zaben shugabancin Amurka
results.content: Tsohuwar sakatariyar harkokin wajen Amurka Hillary Clinton ta kaddamar da yakin neman zabenta na neman tsayawa takarar shugabancin Amurka a jiya asabar, inda ta ce tana fatar kasancewar mace ta farko da za ta jagoranci kasar a tarihi.

results.title: Ƴan gudun hijirar Afirka ta Tsakiya 61,000 ake shirin mayar da su gida daga Chadi
results.content: A Chadi ,alkaluma daga hukumar ƴan gudun hijira na bayyana cewa ƴan gudun hijirar Afirka ta Tsakiya 61,000 daga cikin 147.000 da ke zaune a ƙasar,wandada yanzu haka bayan tattance su ke fatan komawa gida.

results.title: RFI Hausa zai sauya Shafinsa na Intanet
results.content: Daga 15 ga watan Yuni, hausa.rfi.fr, shafin Intanet na RFI Hausa zai sauya sabuwar fuska, mai bayar da muhimmanci kan salon yada labarai irin na rediyo da hotunan bidiyo.

results.title: Sarki Philippe ya ƙi amincewa da murabus na Firaminista Bart De Wever
results.content: A jiya juma’a aka gana tsakanin Sarki Philippe na Belgium da Firaministan ƙasar Bart De Wever wanda ya bayyana aniyarsa na ajiye aikin shugaban gwamnati,bayan gabatar da takardar ajiye aiki ga Sarki Philippe.

results.title: Imane ƴar damben boksin daga Algeria,za ta komawa gasa a 15 ga watan Disamba
results.content: Imane Khelif ƴar damben boksin daga Algeria, za ta koma fagen gasar a ranar 15 ga watan Disamba a birnin Paris a Maison de la Mutualité a karon farko da za ta fafata tsakanin kwararru, da nufin lashe lambar yado ta duniya.

results.title: Ɗaurin shekaru 200 ya hau kan mutumin da ya kashe ɗaruruwan mabiyansa a Kenya
results.content: Kotu ta zartas da hukuncin ɗaurin shekaru 200 kan Paul Meckenzie da ke iƙirarin kasancewa Fasto a Kenya, bayan samunsa da laifin kashe ɗimbin mabiyansa da suka haɗa da ƙananan yara 190 da kuma wani mutum babba guda.

results.title: NDLEA ta gurfanar da wasu ƴan asalin Mexico 2 da ƴan Najeriya 4 gaban kotu
results.content: Hukumar da ke yaƙi da ta'ammali da miyagun ƙwayoyi ta Najeriya NDLEA ta gurfanar da wasu mutane biyu ƴan asalin ƙasar Mexico da kuma wasu ƴan Najeriya guda 4 a gaban babbar kotun tarayya da ke birnin Ibadan, sakamakon zarginsu da hannu wajen kafawa da kuma tafiyar da wani ƙaramin kamfanin sarrafa miyagun ƙwayoyi a ƙauyen Tapa da ke ƙaramar hukumar Ibarapa ta Arewa da ke jihar Oyo.

results.title: An samu ɓullar cutar shawara a Najeriya da wasu ƙasashen Afrika 8
results.content: Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya WHO ta ce an sami ɓullar cutar shawara wato yellow fever a Turance a Najeriya da ƙarin wasu ƙasashen Africa guda 8.

results.title: Isa Sanusi kan yadda Amnesty ke tir da kaiwa ƴan adawa hare-hare a Najeriya
results.content: Ƙungiyar Amnesty International ta bayyana matuƙar damuwa game da hare haren da ake kai wa ƴan adawa a Najeriya, musamman ganin abinda ya faru a jihar Kebbi wajen taron jam'iyyar ADC. Rahotanni sun ce an raunata wasu daga cikin magoya bayan jam'iyyar tare da lalata motocin su.

results.title: Ana bikin cikar Paul Biya shekaru 44 kan karagar mulkin Kamaru
results.content: Yau aka cika shekaru 44 da hawa ƙaragar mulkin shugaban ƙasar Kamaru Paul Biya, wanda ya zama shugaban ƙasa a ranar 6 ga watan Nuwambar shekarar 1982 sakamakon murabus ɗin shugaba Ahmadou Ahidjo.

results.title: Adadin matan da aka ci zarafinsu a Faransa ya tasamma dubu 300-Rahoto
results.content: Alƙaluman da mahukuntan Faransa suka tattara ya nuna cewa har yanzu cin zarafin mata na matsayin babbar matsala a ƙasar ta yammacin Turai inda a shekarar da ta gabata kaɗai aka samu rahoton matan da yawansu ya tasamma dubu 285 da suka fuskanci cin zarafi, alƙaluman da ke nuna ƙaruwar cin zarafin da aƙalla kashi 5 in an kwatanta da wanda aka samu a 2024.

results.title: Kasuwar hannayen jari na fukantar barazana, sakamakon matsaloli a fannin fasahar AI
results.content: An samu gagarumin faɗuwar farashin hannayen jarin kamfanonin fasaha na duniya, lamarin da ya janyo asarar Triliyoyin daloli a manyan kasuwannin hada-hadar kuɗaɗen Amurka sakamakon tafiyar hawainiya a fannin fasahar AI da kuma fargabar bayyanar sabbin dokoki bayan zaɓukan Amurka.
